title: The Flood
reflectionText: Yahweh's own hand shut the door, and for one hundred fifty days the world was only water. Then God remembered Noah — and the sign of it was a wind passing over the deep, and later a dove, carrying one green leaf. What is it to be held through a long ending, watching for the small signs that the water is going down?
